newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-DUTCH MISS KEY PLAYERS FOR WELSH QUALIFYER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUTCH MISS KEY PLAYERS FOR WELSH QUALIFYER.

text.p: Dutch national coach Guus Hiddink had to struggle to find 18 fit players for his squad for the World Cup group seven qualifying match away against Wales on Saturday as several key players were injured.

Hiddink could not call up strikers Patrick Kluivert, Peter Hoekstra and midfielder Richard Witschge and defender John Veldman from Ajax Amsterdam, centre defenders Johan de Kock of Schalke and Jaap Stam and striker Rene Eykelkamp, both of PSV Eindhoven.
Also AC Milan defender Michael Reiziger, who was involved in a car accident last week, also was not fit enough to play in Wales.
To beef up the defence he called back in veteran marker Stan Valckx of PSV, Ferdy Vierklau of Vitesse and Andre Ooyer of Roda JC Kerkrade, will make his debut in the Dutch squad.
Celtic striker Pierre van Hooydonk was called back into the squad after earning two caps in a brief spell early 1995.
Arsenal striker Dennis Bergkamp and Schalke striker Youri Mulder were found fit enough to travel to Wales.
Goalkeepers: Edwin van der Sar (Ajax), Ed de Goey (Feyenoord)
Defenders: Frank de Boer, Winston Bogarde (both Ajax), Stan Valckx, Arthur Numan (both PSV), Ferdy Vierklau (Vitesse) Andre Ooyer (Roda JC)
Midfielders: Ronald de Boer (Ajax), Aron Winter (Inter Milan, Italy) Clarence Seedorf (Real Madrid, Spain), Philip Cocu, Wim Jonk (both PSV), Giovanni van Bronkhorst (Feyenoord)
Strikers: Youri Mulder (Schalke 04, Germany), Dennis Bergkamp (Arsenal, England), Pierre van Hooijdonk (Celtic, Scotland), Jordi Cruijff (Manchester United, England)
